Reliable operations.

I am a water and desalination plant operator experienced in SWRO, BWRO and water treatment plant operations.

My work spans SCADA monitoring, field inspections, RO process operation, high-pressure pumping systems, chemical dosing, water-quality checks and initial troubleshooting. I focus on safe, stable and continuous plant operation while following operating procedures and site HSE requirements.
